title: Feature request: Restore minimized windows on the monitor where the taskbar icon is clicked

status.label: Previously handled feature request
status.detail: The same multi-monitor restore behavior is covered by closed issues #12604 and #38574.

next_action.label: Post duplicate-history response
next_action.reason: The reporter should be directed to the two confirmed prior requests rather than starting parallel design work.

comment.body: Thanks for the detailed scenario. This request is already represented by #12604 (“Restore to this screen”) and #38574 (“Restore application window to arbitrary screen”), both of which describe restoring a minimized window onto a chosen monitor and were closed on April 19, 2026. To keep the product decision and history together, this issue should be closed as already handled by those prior requests rather than starting a third implementation track.

judgment.rationale: Two confirmed prior PowerToys issues cover the same requested multi-monitor restore behavior and are both closed.
evidence: Issue #12604 is titled “Restore to this screen: Open minimized window to specific screen/desktop” and is closed.
Issue #38574 is titled “Restore application window to arbitrary screen” and is closed.
The current request asks for a minimized window to restore on the monitor whose taskbar icon was clicked.
judgment.recommended_action: Post a duplicate-history response linking #12604 and #38574 and close this parallel request.
